mapper.select:
SELECT f.feed_id, f.feed_img_url, COUNT(l.like_id) AS likeCount FROM feed_tb f LEFT JOIN like_tb l ON f.feed_id = l.feed_id WHERE f.create_dt >= date_add(NOW(), INTERVAL -7 DAY) GROUP BY f.feed_id, f.feed_img_url ORDER BY likeCount DESC
LIMIT 8
SELECT f.feed_id, f.feed_img_url FROM feed_tb f LEFT JOIN like_tb l ON f.feed_id = l.feed_id WHERE l.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT f.feed_id, f.user_id, f.feed_img_url, f.feed_location, u.user_id, u.nickname, u.profile_img_url, COUNT(l.like_id) AS likeCount FROM feed_tb f JOIN user_tb u ON f.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN like_tb l ON f.feed_id = l.feed_id GROUP BY f.feed_id, f.user_id, f.feed_img_url, f.feed_location, u.user_id, u.nickname, u.profile_img_url ORDER BY f.create_dt DESC; LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{(page-1) * size}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO feed_tb ( user_id, feed_img_url, feed_status, feed_location, feed_longitude, feed_latitude, create_dt, update_dt ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{feedImgUrl}, #{feedStatus}, #{feedLocation}, #{feedLongitude}, #{feedLatitude}, now(), now() )
